title: 🕊️ “Sometimes it’s not persecution — it’s just our pride losing WiFi.” 📶🔥
paragraphs: 🕊️ “Sometimes it’s not persecution — it’s just our pride losing WiFi.” 📶🔥
We call it ‘spiritual attack’ when really… it’s spiritual accountability. 😅

Losing influence ≠ being persecuted.
Losing integrity = a whole different sermon. 🎤💥
🎬 THE GREAT INFLUENCE MELTDOWN — When the stage lights go out, what’s left shining is character.

“For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world, and forfeit his soul?”
— Mark 8:36 (ESV)
